subject: Re: POC kickoff / next steps for ACME - scope & timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff - recap & proposed next steps

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap so we’re aligned on goals and next steps before we kick off the pilot: 

Pain points you shared:
- Current search & recommendations service has inconsistent latency and high cost under burst traffic
- Existing embeddings pipeline is expensive to update and slow to iterate on prompt changes

POC goals / success metrics (proposed):
- Latency: median inference latency < 180ms for 512-token requests
- Cost: reduce per-request token cost by ~30% vs current infra (your baseline)
- Quality: maintain or improve relevance in top-3 suggestions (A/B on held-out prompt set)

Scope (rough):
- 2-week sandbox POC using a 10k prompt evaluation set you’ll provide
- Integrate Redwood hosted inference with prefix caching + batching for search flow
- Collect latency/cost telemetry and run blind evals on prompt set

Owners / roles:
- ACME: Sam (product lead), Priya Shah (engineering) — will provide dataset and temporary test credentials
- Redwood: me (Eng lead / PM), Aditya (SE, infra access & model tuning), Rishi (solutions, eval design)

Immediate next steps: 
1) ACME to share the 10k prompt sample + a short description of your success criteria (Priya) — target: EOD Thu (2/19)
2) ACME to fill out network/access checklist so we can spin up private sandbox (see attached)
3) Redwood to send final POC scope doc & kickoff agenda (attached: redwood-poc-scope.pdf)

If that looks right I’ll schedule a 30–45m kickoff for early next week and loop in infra.

Thanks,
Marissa 
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0117

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, contracts@acme.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 18:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - recap & proposed next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. That all aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications and notes from our side: 

- We can share the 10k prompt sample by EOD 2/19. Priya will own delivery and the format will be CSV with source type tags.
- For success criteria, product would like to prioritize latency and top-3 relevance; we’ll provide the baseline numbers in the same CSV.
- Procurement: copied contracts — we’ll need a short SOW and a standard mutual NDA addendum. Can Redwood provide a one-page SOW template?

One ask: can the POC include a small internal dataset (50k rows) that’s not production data, just a representative export? Priya, can you confirm this is doable?

Go ahead and schedule kickoff for Monday or Tuesday next week — mornings PST are best for our team.

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Head of Product
ACME Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - recap & proposed next steps

Sam / Priya —

Great — thanks for the quick reply. Below is the final POC kickoff summary and proposed schedule so we can share internally at ACME and Redwood.

POC KICKOFF SUMMARY (final)
Scope:
- Integrate Redwood hosted inference endpoint with ACME’s staging search service (non-prod dataset, ~50k rows)
- Run evaluation across the 10k prompt set you provide and a 2k holdout for blind A/B
- Provide telemetry: per-request latency distribution, GPU utilization, per-token cost estimates, and per-route cost breakdown

Success Metrics:
- Median inference latency < 180ms for 512-token requests
- >=30% reduction in per-request token cost vs baseline (to be measured across same workload)
- Top-3 suggestion relevance: meet or exceed baseline on blind eval (we’ll use your holdout)

Prompt set / evals:
- ACME provides: 10k labeled prompts + baseline metrics CSV, and 2k holdout (blind)
- Redwood provides: eval harness (scripts) + scoring rubric, will run blind evals and share results in a report

Timeline (target):
- Thu 2/19: ACME shares prompt CSV + baseline numbers; returns network checklist
- Fri 2/20: Redwood prepares sandbox & initial config; SOW template sent to contracts@acme.com
- Mon 2/23: Kickoff meeting (30–45m) 
- Week of 2/23-3/05: Active integration, regular syncs twice/week; interim telemetry checks
- Fri 3/06: POC results & final report

Owners:
- ACME: Sam (product), Priya (engineering), contracts@acme.com (procurement)
- Redwood: Marissa (eng lead / sales), Aditya (SE — infra & token cost analysis), Rishi (solutions — evals)

Access & setup steps:
1) ACME to complete network-access-checklist.xlsx and share credentials for a staging service endpoint (temporary test token)
2) Redwood SE will request IP allowlist entries (we’ll provide IP ranges)
3) Redwood will provision a sandbox project and share a short runbook with API keys + telemetry dashboard links

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope.pdf (updated), network-access-checklist.xlsx

Action items (owners):
- Priya: share prompt CSV + holdout by EOD 2/19 (ACME)
- Priya: confirm staging dataset availability (50k rows) — reply to thread
- Marissa: send SOW template + schedule kickoff (Marissa)
- Aditya: prepare IP ranges & sandbox provisioning checklist (Aditya)

Would Monday 2/23 at 9:30am PST work for kickoff? If so I’ll schedule and include a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, contracts@acme.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - recap & proposed next steps

Marissa / team —

Thanks — Monday 2/23 9:30am PST works for us. Priya confirms we can provide the 10k CSV and the 50k staging export (non-prod). Contracts: please find the ACME PO details and we’ll review the SOW when you send it.

Looking forward to kickoff.
—Sam
